title: A Mapped List in a Written Segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $d\in\mathbb{N}$, let $g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and let $L$ be a finite list of integers. Write the values $g(L_i)$ into $\mu$ starting at $d$, using the offset $i$ for each entry. The resulting sequence represents the list obtained by applying $g$ to each entry of $L$, starting at $d$.
replaced:
Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, $g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and let $L$ be a finite
list of integers. Define a sequence to equal $g(L_i)$ at indices $a$ from $d$ through
$d+|L|-1$, using the offset $i=a-d$, and to equal $\mu(a)$ elsewhere. The values of this
sequence starting at index $d$ agree with the list obtained by applying $g$ to each
entry of $L$.
